prompt:
Hey, you're the Medic agent. Build a /health page for Mission Control that shows system integrity at a glance.

This page should be the "is everything working?" dashboard. Model the visual style after the /cost page's data cards: clean sections, KEY METRIC badges, color-coded status, actionable insights. Not a wall of text.

Build these sections:

1. API Health: hit every MC API endpoint and show green/red status with response time. Endpoints: /api/agents, /api/campaigns, /api/dispatch, /api/findings, /api/areas, /api/workstreams, /api/mode, /api/toolbox-context, /api/northstar

2. Data Integrity: count state files, log files, prompt files. Flag orphans (state without log, log without state). Check JSON validity of key files (campaigns.json, dispatch-home.json, dispatch-work.json, findings.json, workstreams.json). Show file sizes.

3. Hook Health: check if hook.js and prompt-hook.js exist and are valid JS. Show last state file modification time (indicates hooks are firing). Count active vs stale vs archived sessions.

4. Regression Detection: curl each MC page route (/, /dispatch, /findings, /campaigns, /workflow, /postmortems, /tools, /logic, /radar, /cost, /why, /prompts) and verify 200 status + check for key content markers (e.g., dispatch page should contain "Dispatch", campaigns should contain "Campaign Debrief"). Flag any page returning errors or missing expected content.

5. Session Stats: active sessions count, total sessions, average session duration, most active session today.

Create the page at .claude/agent-hub/health-page.html. Wire it in server.js as a route at /health (same pattern as /why — add the route near the other page routes).

Read CLAUDE.md at C:\Users\ephra\phredomade\CLAUDE.md first.

Key files:
- .claude/agent-hub/server.js (add /health route, study existing API endpoints)
- .claude/agent-hub/hook.js (understand what hooks write)
- .claude/agent-hub/states/ (session state files)
- .claude/agent-hub/logs/ (activity logs)
- All JSON data files in .claude/agent-hub/

The page should auto-refresh every 30 seconds. Use fetch() to hit the APIs from the browser. For regression detection, add a server-side API endpoint GET /api/health that runs the checks and returns JSON.

DON'T touch dispatch-page.html, campaigns-page.html, findings.json, hook.js, or prompt-hook.js.

Design: Plus Jakarta Sans headings, DM Sans body, DM Mono for data. Apple-inspired, clean cards. Green for healthy, red for broken, amber for warnings. CLAUDE.md Rule #10 applies.

Tell me your plan before building.
did u verify stale server. i dont see health on nav bar
Yeah I want you to add it to an actual page. It doesn't have to be hidden.

Also health should track latency as well for each page. For example sometimes I want to be able to know how long it takes to load the dashboard, which is something that I need to be able to do so improve on this and do this right now.Also before you do that if you have any other suggestions for what you think you should add in the same pass-through that may not be included, please do so now. If not just work.
Okay good job. I'm about to close you now.
